verses.original: עוּרִ֥י עוּרִ֛י לִבְשִׁ֥י עֻזֵּ֖ךְ צִיּ֑וֹן לִבְשִׁ֣י׀ בִּגְדֵ֣י תִפְאַרְתֵּ֗ךְ יְרוּשָׁלִַ֙ם֙ עִ֣יר הַקֹּ֔דֶשׁ כִּ֣י לֹ֥א יוֹסִ֛יף יָבֹא־ בָ֥ךְ ע֖וֹד עָרֵ֥ל וְטָמֵֽא׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ū·rî ‘ū·rî liḇ·šî ‘uz·zêḵ ṣî·yō·wn liḇ·šî biḡ·ḏê ṯip̄·’ar·têḵ yə·rū·šā·lim ‘îr haq·qō·ḏeš kî lō yō·w·sîp̄ yā·ḇō- ḇāḵ ‘ō·wḏ ‘ā·rêl wə·ṭā·mê
verses.literal: Awake awake clothe yourself with strength O Zion Put on your garments of splendor O Jerusalem holy city For the uncircumcised and unclean will no longer . . . enter you
verses.literalPt: DESPERTA, desperta, veste-te da tua fortaleza, ó Sião; veste-te das tuas roupas formosas, ó Jerusalém, cidade santa, porque nunca mais entrará em ti nem incircunciso nem imundo.

verses.original: הִתְנַעֲרִ֧י מֵעָפָ֛ר ק֥וּמִי שְּׁבִ֖י יְרֽוּשָׁלִָ֑ם הִתְפַּתְּחוּ מוֹסְרֵ֣י צַוָּארֵ֔ךְ שְׁבִיָּ֖ה בַּת־ צִיּֽוֹן׃ס
verses.transliteration: hiṯ·na·‘ă·rî mê·‘ā·p̄ār qū·mî šə·ḇî yə·rū·šā·lim hiṯ·pat·tə·ḥū mō·ws·rê ṣaw·wā·rêḵ šə·ḇî·yāh baṯ- ṣî·yō·wn
verses.literal: Shake off your dust Rise up and sit on your throne O Jerusalem Remove the chains from your neck O captive Daughter of Zion
verses.literalPt: Sacode-te do pó, levanta-te, e assenta-te, ó Jerusalém: solta-te das cadeias de teu pescoço, ó cativa filha de Sião.

verses.original: כִּֽי־ כֹה֙ אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה חִנָּ֖ם נִמְכַּרְתֶּ֑ם וְלֹ֥א בְכֶ֖סֶף תִּגָּאֵֽלוּ׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ḵōh ’ā·mar Yah·weh ḥin·nām nim·kar·tem wə·lō ḇə·ḵe·sep̄ tig·gā·’ê·lū
verses.literal: For this is what the LORD says You were sold for nothing and without money you will be redeemed
verses.literalPt: Porque assim diz o SENHOR: Por nada fostes vendidos; também sem dinheiro sereis resgatados.

verses.original: כִּ֣י כֹ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה מִצְרַ֛יִם יָֽרַד־ עַמִּ֥י בָרִֽאשֹׁנָ֖ה לָג֣וּר שָׁ֑ם וְאַשּׁ֖וּר בְּאֶ֥פֶס עֲשָׁקֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: kî ḵōh ’ā·mar ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh miṣ·ra·yim yā·raḏ- ‘am·mî ḇā·ri·šō·nāh lā·ḡūr šām wə·’aš·šūr bə·’e·p̄es ‘ă·šā·qōw
verses.literal: For this is what the Lord GOD says At first My people went down to Egypt to live . . . then Assyria oppressed them without cause
verses.literalPt: Porque assim diz o Senhor DEUS: O meu povo em tempos passados desceu ao Egito, para peregrinar lá, e a Assíria sem razão o oprimiu.

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֤ה מִי־ לִי פֹה֙ נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֔ה כִּֽי־ לֻקַּ֥ח עַמִּ֖י חִנָּ֑ם מֹשְׁלוֹ יְהֵילִ֙ילוּ֙ נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֔ה וְתָמִ֥יד כָּל־ הַיּ֖וֹם שְׁמִ֥י מִנֹּאָֽץ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh mī- lī p̄ōh nə·’um- Yah·weh kî- luq·qaḥ ‘am·mî ḥin·nām mō·šə·lō yə·hê·lî·lū nə·’um- Yah·weh wə·ṯā·mîḏ kāl- hay·yō·wm šə·mî min·nō·’āṣ
verses.literal: And now what have I here declares the LORD For My people have been taken without cause those who rule them taunt declares the LORD and My name is blasphemed continually all day long . . .
verses.literalPt: E agora, que tenho eu que fazer aqui, diz o SENHOR, pois o meu povo foi tomado sem nenhuma razão? Os que dominam sobre ele dão uivos, diz o SENHOR; e o meu nome é blasfemado incessantemente o dia todo.

verses.original: לָכֵ֛ן יֵדַ֥ע עַמִּ֖י שְׁמִ֑י לָכֵן֙ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֔וּא כִּֽי־ אֲנִי־ ה֥וּא הַֽמְדַבֵּ֖ר הִנֵּֽנִי׃
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên yê·ḏa‘ ‘am·mî šə·mî lā·ḵên bay·yō·wm ha·hū kî- ’ă·nî- hū ham·ḏab·bêr hin·nê·nî
verses.literal: Therefore My people will know My name therefore they will know on that day that I am He who speaks Here I am
verses.literalPt: Portanto o meu povo saberá o meu nome; pois, naquele dia, saberá que sou eu mesmo o que falo: Eis-me aqui.

verses.original: מַה־ נָּאו֨וּ עַל־ הֶהָרִ֜ים רַגְלֵ֣י מְבַשֵּׂ֗ר מַשְׁמִ֧יעַ שָׁל֛וֹם מְבַשֵּׂ֥ר ט֖וֹב מַשְׁמִ֣יעַ יְשׁוּעָ֑ה אֹמֵ֥ר לְצִיּ֖וֹן מָלַ֥ךְ אֱלֹהָֽיִךְ׃
verses.transliteration: mah- nā·wū ‘al- he·hā·rîm raḡ·lê mə·ḇaś·śêr maš·mî·a‘ šā·lō·wm mə·ḇaś·śêr ṭō·wḇ maš·mî·a‘ yə·šū·‘āh ’ō·mêr lə·ṣî·yō·wn mā·laḵ ’ĕ·lō·hā·yiḵ
verses.literal: How beautiful on the mountains are the feet of those who bring good news who proclaim peace who bring good tidings who proclaim salvation who say to Zion Your God reigns
verses.literalPt: Quão formosos são, sobre os montes, os pés do que anuncia as boas novas, que faz ouvir a paz, do que anuncia o bem, que faz ouvir a salvação, do que diz a Sião: O teu Deus reina!

verses.original: ק֥וֹל צֹפַ֛יִךְ נָ֥שְׂאוּ ק֖וֹל יַחְדָּ֣ו יְרַנֵּ֑נוּ כִּ֣י עַ֤יִן בְּעַ֙יִן֙ יִרְא֔וּ בְּשׁ֥וּב יְהוָ֖ה צִיּֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: qō·wl ṣō·p̄a·yiḵ nā·śə·’ū qō·wl yaḥ·dāw yə·ran·nê·nū kî ‘a·yin bə·‘a·yin yir·’ū bə·šūḇ Yah·weh ṣî·yō·wn
verses.literal: Listen Your watchmen lift up their voices together they shout for joy For every eye . . . will see when the LORD returns to Zion
verses.literalPt: Eis a voz dos teus atalaias! Eles alçam a voz, juntamente exultam; porque olho a olho verão, quando o SENHOR fizer Sião voltar.

verses.original: פִּצְח֤וּ רַנְּנוּ֙ יַחְדָּ֔ו חָרְב֖וֹת יְרוּשָׁלִָ֑ם כִּֽי־ נִחַ֤ם יְהוָה֙ עַמּ֔וֹ גָּאַ֖ל יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: piṣ·ḥū ran·nə·nū yaḥ·dāw ḥā·rə·ḇō·wṯ yə·rū·šā·lim kî- ni·ḥam Yah·weh ‘am·mōw gā·’al yə·rū·šā·lim
verses.literal: Break forth in joy sing together O ruins of Jerusalem for the LORD has comforted His people He has redeemed Jerusalem
verses.literalPt: Clamai cantando, exultai juntamente, desertos de Jerusalém; porque o SENHOR consolou o seu povo, remiu a Jerusalém.

verses.original: חָשַׂ֤ף יְהוָה֙ אֶת־ זְר֣וֹעַ קָדְשׁ֔וֹ לְעֵינֵ֖י כָּל־ הַגּוֹיִ֑ם וְרָאוּ֙ כָּל־ אַפְסֵי־ אָ֔רֶץ אֵ֖ת יְשׁוּעַ֥ת אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ׃ס
verses.transliteration: ḥā·śap̄ Yah·weh ’eṯ- zə·rō·w·a‘ qā·ḏə·šōw lə·‘ê·nê kāl- hag·gō·w·yim wə·rā·’ū kāl- ’ap̄·sê- ’ā·reṣ ’êṯ yə·šū·‘aṯ ’ĕ·lō·hê·nū
verses.literal: The LORD has bared His holy arm in the sight of all the nations all the ends of the earth will see the salvation of our God
verses.literalPt: O SENHOR desnudou o seu santo braço perante os olhos de todas as nações; e todos os confins da terra verão a salvação do nosso Deus.

verses.original: ס֤וּרוּ ס֙וּרוּ֙ צְא֣וּ מִשָּׁ֔ם טָמֵ֖א אַל־ תִּגָּ֑עוּ צְא֣וּ מִתּוֹכָ֔הּ הִבָּ֕רוּ נֹשְׂאֵ֖י כְּלֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: sū·rū sū·rū ṣə·’ū miš·šām ṭā·mê ’al- tig·gā·‘ū ṣə·’ū mit·tō·w·ḵāh hib·bā·rū nō·śə·’ê kə·lê Yah·weh
verses.literal: Depart depart go out from there Touch no unclean thing come out from it purify yourselves you who carry the vessels of the LORD
verses.literalPt: Retirai-vos, retirai-vos, saí daí, não toqueis coisa imunda; saí do meio dela, purificai-vos, os que levais os vasos do SENHOR.

verses.original: כִּ֣י לֹ֤א בְחִפָּזוֹן֙ תֵּצֵ֔אוּ וּבִמְנוּסָ֖ה לֹ֣א תֵלֵכ֑וּן כִּֽי־ הֹלֵ֤ךְ לִפְנֵיכֶם֙ יְהוָ֔ה וּמְאַסִּפְכֶ֖ם אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ס
verses.transliteration: kî lō ḇə·ḥip·pā·zō·wn tê·ṣê·’ū ū·ḇim·nū·sāh lō ṯê·lê·ḵūn kî- hō·lêḵ lip̄·nê·ḵem Yah·weh ū·mə·’as·sip̄·ḵem ’ĕ·lō·hê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: For you will not leave in a hurry nor flee in haste for the LORD goes before you and the God of Israel is your rear guard
verses.literalPt: Porque vós não saireis apressadamente, nem ireis fugindo; porque o SENHOR irá diante de vós, e o Deus de Israel será a vossa retaguarda.

verses.original: הִנֵּ֥ה יַשְׂכִּ֖יל עַבְדִּ֑י יָר֧וּם וְנִשָּׂ֛א וְגָבַ֖הּ מְאֹֽד׃
verses.transliteration: hin·nêh yaś·kîl ‘aḇ·dî yā·rūm wə·niś·śā wə·ḡā·ḇah mə·’ōḏ
verses.literal: Behold My Servant will prosper He will be raised and lifted up and highly exalted
verses.literalPt: Eis que o meu servo procederá com prudência; será exaltado, e elevado, e mui sublime.

verses.original: כַּאֲשֶׁ֨ר שָׁמְמ֤וּ עָלֶ֙יךָ֙ רַבִּ֔ים כֵּן־ מִשְׁחַ֥ת מֵאִ֖ישׁ מַרְאֵ֑הוּ וְתֹאֲר֖וֹ מִבְּנֵ֥י אָדָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ka·’ă·šer šā·mə·mū ‘ā·le·ḵā rab·bîm kên- miš·ḥaṯ mê·’îš mar·’ê·hū wə·ṯō·’ă·rōw mib·bə·nê ’ā·ḏām
verses.literal: Just as many . . . were appalled at Him His appearance was disfigured beyond that of any man and His form was marred beyond human likeness . . .
verses.literalPt: Como pasmaram muitos à vista dele, pois o seu parecer estava tão desfigurado, mais do que o de outro qualquer, e a sua figura mais do que a dos outros filhos dos homens.

verses.original: כֵּ֤ן יַזֶּה֙ גּוֹיִ֣ם רַבִּ֔ים עָלָ֛יו יִקְפְּצ֥וּ מְלָכִ֖ים פִּיהֶ֑ם כִּ֠י אֲשֶׁ֨ר לֹֽא־ סֻפַּ֤ר לָהֶם֙ רָא֔וּ וַאֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹֽא־ שָׁמְע֖וּ הִתְבּוֹנָֽנוּ׃
verses.transliteration: kên yaz·zeh gō·w·yim rab·bîm ‘ā·lāw yiq·pə·ṣū mə·lā·ḵîm pî·hem kî ’ă·šer lō- sup·par lā·hem rā·’ū wa·’ă·šer lō- šā·mə·‘ū hiṯ·bō·w·nā·nū
verses.literal: so He will sprinkle many nations Kings will shut their mouths because of Him For they will see what they have not been told and they will understand what they have not heard
verses.literalPt: Assim borrifará muitas nações, e os reis fecharão as suas bocas por causa dele; porque aquilo que não lhes foi anunciado verão, e aquilo que eles não ouviram entenderão.
